projects.title: Brand Size Matcher
projects.tagline: Know your size in one brand? Find your match across 18 others.
projects.problem: Clothing sizes are a mess. A Medium in Zara fits nothing like a Medium in H&M. Every online purchase is a gamble, and returns are a pain.
projects.solution: Built a tool that uses IoU-based measurement matching to translate your known size in one brand to equivalent sizes across 18 brands — international and Indian D2C labels included.

projects.title: Valentine Magic 8 Ball
projects.tagline: A Magic 8 Ball that only says yes — with Telugu memes.
projects.problem: Needed a fun, creative way to ask someone to be my Valentine. Regular cards are boring.
projects.solution: Built an interactive 3D Magic 8 Ball that you shake to reveal Telugu memes. It cycles through 8 hand-picked memes, has sparkle cursor trails, floating hearts, and confetti animations. The answer is always yes.

projects.title: This Portfolio + Admin CMS
projects.tagline: A static portfolio with a hidden admin editor that commits to GitHub.
projects.problem: Wanted a portfolio site I could edit from my phone without touching code or a CMS dashboard.
projects.solution: Built a static site on GitHub Pages with a hidden /signin admin panel. Login, edit content in a form-based editor, hit save — it commits directly to the GitHub repo and the site updates in 2 minutes.
